provenance.steps: Monthly SMMs of monthly_smm.csv, chosen by hand. Over the first n months (n = 3 and 12) the realised CPR is 1 - (prod (1 - SMM))^(12/n), computed exactly in rationals (exponent 4 and 1); the average of the n monthly CPRs, 1 - (1 - SMM)^12 each, is computed the same way as the wrong figure the case rules out. Both rounded to 40 significant digits.
